name: Rust toolchains (rustup)
setup: command -v rustup >/dev/null || curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -fsSL https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y --profile default --default-toolchain none
install: rustup toolchain install "$1" && { rustup default >/dev/null 2>&1 || rustup default "$1"; }
list: rustup toolchain list | while read -r t _; do echo "$(echo "$t" | sed 's/-[^-]*-unknown-linux-gnu$//') $(rustc +"$t" --version | cut -d' ' -f2)"; done
